plain_english_policy: Alabama Consolidated Income Tax Return Policy for Affiliated Groups
policy_direction_if_enacted: This policy outlines how Alabama affiliated groups (a group of corporations under common control) can file a consolidated income tax return in Alabama. Here’s a breakdown of the key points:
evidence_quotes: The election to file a consolidated return must be made by the common parent or designated member of the Alabama affiliated group.
Transactions between members of an Alabama affiliated group should be reported on an arm’s-length basis for allocation and apportionment purposes.
Each member of the Alabama affiliated group is considered a separate taxpayer for allocation and apportionment purposes, but they can deduct losses against each other if allocated to Alabama.
review_reason: The policy involves complex tax regulations that require careful interpretation and application. Human review is necessary to ensure compliance with federal regulations and accurate implementation of state-specific rules.
